title: Land Registry issues warning over conveyancer deed failures
summary:
The Land Registry has warned conveyancers that repeated failures to properly check property deeds or instances of losing them could result in referrals for disciplinary investigation. Serene Rollins, Assistant Registrar at Land Registry, confirmed that conveyancers could be referred to the Solicitors Regulation Authority or the Council for Licensed Conveyancers if standards are not maintained.

title: Greater Manchester mayor’s rental property funded via expenses
summary:
Greater Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham's housing policy positions have come under renewed scrutiny following reports that he purchased a London rental property with assistance from the parliamentary expenses system. The two-bedroom former council flat in Kennington, acquired for £215,000 in 2005, is now valued at approximately £480,000.

summary:

title: Private rental sector doubles as families replace young singles
summary:
Britain's private rented sector has more than doubled since 2000, with 3.2 million children now living in rental homes. The demographic shift sees families increasingly viewing private renting as a permanent housing solution rather than a temporary arrangement.

title: Bradford landlord convicted of HMO safety violations
summary:

Hasan Kazi, who owns 18 properties housing approximately 100 tenants, was convicted following a prosecution by Bradford Council.

title: Former Norfolk agent faces fraud charges totalling £50,000
summary:
A former Norfolk estate agent has appeared in court facing 19 charges of fraud by false representation totalling approximately £50,000. Victoria Steele, 51, who operated Swaffham-based eHomes between 2011 and 2018, is accused of withholding landlord rental payments and failing to protect tenant deposits.
